articles.title: Tesco to sell Czech and Slovak businesses for €1.7bn
articles.summary: The proposed disposal covers all Tesco stores and offices in the two countries, as well as distribution centres in Kralupy, Presov and Beckov.

articles.title: Tesco sells central European arm for £1.5bn in global retreat
articles.summary: Tesco has nearly completed the breakup of its once-sprawling global retail empire with the £1.5bn sale of its Czech and Slovak stores.
